headlines.text: Flash back to 2022, when Claudio Castagnoli vs. Dustin Rhodes went to battle over the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.36. Championship gold always raises the stakes.
Flash back to 2023, when Cassidy, Kingston & Penta touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 5.21.
Turning the clock back to 2026: Young Bucks & Copeland arrived in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.18.

secondaries.text: On a Friday in 2022, back when Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) & Ten arrived in AEW as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.47.
